altText: A male Purple Finch on a branch, raspberry colour washing over his head, back and wings rather than only his front.
A male Purple Finch facing the camera, deep raspberry over the head and breast fading to pale below.
A female Purple Finch, brown and heavily streaked, with a bold white stripe over the eye and a dark cheek patch.
A female Purple Finch perched among twigs, showing the strong pale eyebrow that separates her from a House Finch.
